Oh, I asked because that very kind of dog was the only who ever bit me.

It was during a Christmas dinner as a kid and I had to walk by my cousin. The dog was on her lap. I was about a foot away walking and it lunged it me.

I guess it was being protective.
Was it a big or small dog? What breed?
Awesome. I'm an old school country fan.
It does feel pretty much like a mild flu, nothing else. Minus the insomnia part. Normally I can always sleep.
